papers.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
papers.abstract: Frames agent decisions as conditional prediction. A frozen, shared pretrained predictor uses language-model embeddings of past records to forecast task targets, with no parameter updates, and raises accuracy.

papers.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
papers.abstract: A final-stage training method that keeps early denoising close to the base model and corrects preservation near the trajectory tail, reducing visual drift over 15-20 editing turns.

papers.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
papers.abstract: Introduces PLatour, a framework linking a large prefill model to a small generator via trainable bridges. Controlled tests show some gains can come from non-informative signals, so the authors propose PACT-Check.

papers.title: HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
papers.abstract: A hierarchical vision-language-action framework that keeps task history as explicit language, updated on detected events. It improves success on non-Markovian real-world manipulation tasks while using less memory.

papers.title: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
papers.abstract: Trains sparse autoencoders on MoE layer outputs to attribute latent features to individual experts. Finds contribution is more concentrated than routing, with experts specializing below coarse domains.

papers.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
papers.abstract: A containerized benchmark of 18 contest modeling problems where agents return a JSON answer. Scores are checked against multiple expert papers and gated by feasibility verification.

papers.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
papers.abstract: A position paper arguing for AI-augmented human intelligence through lifelong, proactive cognitive companions that address working-memory limits, along with governance risks they introduce.

papers.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
papers.abstract: A linear attention architecture that reallocates gate parameters by sensitivity, reweights state rows at readout, and uses a stable parallel update. It improves perplexity and long-context recall over baselines.

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.abstract: Hundreds of low-cost agents reason in latent space and share KV caches, with a novelty filter keeping distinct ideas. It reaches top scores on 21 math and science problems much faster than other frameworks.

papers.title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Merges capability distillation and few-step distillation for text-to-image diffusion into one training stage, using frozen specialist teachers on the student's own rollouts. Cuts GPU-hours by about 37%.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

* Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
* Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
* Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it...

What's changed

* Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
* Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
* Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
* Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
* Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
* Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed...

What's changed

* Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
* Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
* Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
* Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
* Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave...
